name: HasStrictFDerivAt.fun_pow'
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' x) (n : ℕ) : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x ↦ f x ^ n) (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f x ^ (n.pred - i) •> f' <• f x ^ i) x

name: HasFDerivWithinAt.fun_pow'
statement: HasFDerivWithinAt f f' s x) (n : ℕ) : HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x ↦ f x ^ n) (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f x ^ (n.pred - i) •> f' <• f x ^ i) s x

name: HasFDerivAt.fun_pow'
statement: HasFDerivAt f f' x) (n : ℕ) : HasFDerivAt (fun x ↦ f x ^ n) (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f x ^ (n.pred - i) •> f' <• f x ^ i) x
